content.text:
* Single-stage folded-cascode precision OTA.
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* NMOS reference, input tail, and PMOS bias conversion.
XREF IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=4 nf=1 m=1
XTAIL TAIL IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=80 l=4 nf=1 m=1
XBPULL BP IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=4 nf=1 m=1
XBP BP BP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=1
* Wide-swing cascode gate biases.
XBCP BPC BPC VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=7.5 l=3 nf=1 m=1
XBCNS BPC IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=4 nf=1 m=1
XBCPS BNC BP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XBCN BNC BNC VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4.5 l=3 nf=1 m=1
* Input pair and folding current sources.
XINP DP VINP TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=3 nf=1 m=2
XINN DN VINN TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=3 nf=1 m=2
XTP DP BP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=90 l=2 nf=1 m=2
XTN DN BP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=90 l=2 nf=1 m=2
* Folded branches and cascoded NMOS current mirror.
XFCP NM BPC DP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=3 nf=1 m=1
XFCN VOUT BPC DN VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=3 nf=1 m=1
XNMR NR NM VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=4 nf=1 m=1
XNMO NO NM VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=4 nf=1 m=1
XNCR NM BNC NR VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=3 nf=1 m=1
XNCO VOUT BNC NO VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=3 nf=1 m=1
* Dominant output-pole compensation.
CD VOUT VSS 20p
.ends DUT
